title: The Wooding problem revisited
summary: The threshold conditions to convective instability in a semi-infinite porous layer saturated by a fluid are determined. The classical setup for this problem in geothermal fluid dynamics was originally modelled by Wooding in 1960. Its formulation is here reconsidered to allow for an imperfect heat transfer across the boundary, parametrised through the Biot number. The temperature boundary condition considered by Wooding is here recovered as the limit of an infinite Biot number.
